# Terraform — 50 Complete Real-Time Troubleshooting Scenario Codes
**This is the corrected version:** every scenario below contains actual Terraform HCL that can configure and create infrastructure. For failures that cannot be generated by HCL alone—credentials, IAM, CI concurrency, backend locks, Git history, manual drift—the code provides the working infrastructure and the exact external failure injection.
**Safety:** use a disposable AWS account. These examples create billable resources. Never use production credentials or production state.
## Standard workflow

```bash
terraform init
terraform fmt
terraform validate
terraform plan
terraform apply
```

After injecting the failure, troubleshoot first, fix the root cause, then run `terraform plan` and review the complete change before `terraform apply`.

---

# Scenario 01: terraform init fails

**What you are reproducing:** Change the AWS provider version to an unavailable version.

**Primary command:** `terraform init`

## Complete Terraform code

```hcl
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 6.55"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.aws_region
}

variable "aws_region" {
  type    = string
  default = "ap-south-1"
}

variable "name_prefix" {
  type    = string
  default = "tf-trouble-lab"
}

data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

data "aws_ami" "amazon_linux" {
  most_recent = true
  owners      = ["amazon"]

  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["al2023-ami-*-x86_64"]
  }

  filter {
    name   = "state"
    values = ["available"]
  }
}

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = "10.70.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-vpc" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_a" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.1.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-a" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_b" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.2.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[1]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-b" }
}

resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id
  tags   = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-igw" }
}

resource "aws_route_table" "public" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  route {
    cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-rt" }
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "a" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_a.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "b" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_b.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group" "web" {
  name   = "${var.name_prefix}-web-sg"
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description = "HTTP"
    from_port   = 80
    to_port     = 80
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_instance" "web" {
  count                       = 2
  ami                         = data.aws_ami.amazon_linux.id
  instance_type               = "t3.micro"
  subnet_id                   = count.index == 0 ? aws_subnet.public_a.id : aws_subnet.public_b.id
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  associate_public_ip_address = true

  user_data = <<-EOF
    #!/bin/bash
    dnf install -y nginx
    systemctl enable nginx
    systemctl start nginx
    echo "Terraform troubleshooting lab $(hostname)" > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
  EOF

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-web-${count.index + 1}"
  }
}

resource "aws_lb" "app" {
  name               = "${var.name_prefix}-alb"
  load_balancer_type = "application"
  security_groups    = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  subnets            = [aws_subnet.public_a.id, aws_subnet.public_b.id]
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group" "app" {
  name     = "${var.name_prefix}-tg"
  port     = 80
  protocol = "HTTP"
  vpc_id   = aws_vpc.main.id

  health_check {
    path                = "/"
    port                = "traffic-port"
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 2
    interval            = 15
    timeout             = 5
  }
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group_attachment" "web" {
  count            = 2
  target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  target_id        = aws_instance.web[count.index].id
  port             = 80
}

resource "aws_lb_listener" "http" {
  load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.app.arn
  port              = 80
  protocol          = "HTTP"

  default_action {
    type             = "forward"
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "lab" {
  bucket        = "${var.name_prefix}-${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}"
  force_destroy = true

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-bucket"
  }
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

output "account_id" {
  value = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
}

output "region" {
  value = var.aws_region
}

output "alb_dns_name" {
  value = aws_lb.app.dns_name
}

output "instance_ids" {
  value = aws_instance.web[*].id
}

output "vpc_id" {
  value = aws_vpc.main.id
}

output "s3_bucket" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.lab.bucket
}

```

## Failure injection / test

1. Deploy the baseline with `terraform init`, `terraform validate`, `terraform plan`, and `terraform apply`.
2. Apply this scenario's failure injection: **Change the AWS provider version to an unavailable version.**
3. Run `terraform init` and capture the exact symptom.
4. Check configuration → state → AWS remote resource → account/region → permissions/network/dependencies as applicable.
5. Fix the root cause.
6. Run `terraform plan` and inspect the blast radius.
7. Apply and verify the infrastructure.
8. For external-failure scenarios, restore the external system/credentials/backend/CI state after the test.

**What you are reproducing:** Change a resource argument to an invalid Terraform type/value.

```hcl
terraform {

    aws = {

      version = "~> 6.55"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.aws_region
}

variable "aws_region" {
  type    = string
  default = "ap-south-1"
}

variable "name_prefix" {
  type    = string
  default = "tf-trouble-lab"
}

data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

data "aws_ami" "amazon_linux" {
  most_recent = true
  owners      = ["amazon"]

  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["al2023-ami-*-x86_64"]
  }

  filter {
    name   = "state"
    values = ["available"]
  }
}

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = "10.70.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-vpc" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_a" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.1.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-a" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_b" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.2.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[1]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-b" }
}

resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id
  tags   = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-igw" }
}

resource "aws_route_table" "public" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  route {
    cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-rt" }
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "a" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_a.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "b" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_b.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group" "web" {
```

```hcl
    description = "HTTP"
    from_port   = 80
    to_port     = 80
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_instance" "web" {
  count                       = 2
  ami                         = data.aws_ami.amazon_linux.id
  instance_type               = "t3.micro"
  subnet_id                   = count.index == 0 ? aws_subnet.public_a.id : aws_subnet.public_b.id

    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-web-${count.index + 1}"

resource "aws_lb" "app" {
  name               = "${var.name_prefix}-alb"

  subnets            = [aws_subnet.public_a.id, aws_subnet.public_b.id]
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group" "app" {

}

resource "aws_lb_target_group_attachment" "web" {

  target_id        = aws_instance.web[count.index].id

}

resource "aws_lb_listener" "http" {

  port              = 80

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

output "account_id" {

}

output "region" {

}

output "instance_ids" {
  value = aws_instance.web[*].id
}

output "vpc_id" {
  value = aws_vpc.main.id
}

output "s3_bucket" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.lab.bucket
}

# INTENTIONAL FAILURE:
```

```hcl
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group" "web" {
  name   = "${var.name_prefix}-web-sg"
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description = "HTTP"
    from_port   = 80
    to_port     = 80
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_instance" "web" {
  count                       = 2
  ami                         = data.aws_ami.amazon_linux.id
  instance_type               = "t3.micro"
  subnet_id                   = aws_subnet.public_b.id
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  associate_public_ip_address = true

  user_data = <<-EOF
    #!/bin/bash
    dnf install -y nginx
    systemctl enable nginx
    systemctl start nginx
    echo "Terraform troubleshooting lab $(hostname)" > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
  EOF

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-web-${count.index + 1}"
  }
}

resource "aws_lb" "app" {
  name               = "${var.name_prefix}-alb"
  load_balancer_type = "application"
  security_groups    = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  subnets            = [aws_subnet.public_a.id, aws_subnet.public_b.id]
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group" "app" {
  name     = "${var.name_prefix}-tg"
  port     = 80
  protocol = "HTTP"
  vpc_id   = aws_vpc.main.id

  health_check {
    path                = "/"
    port                = "traffic-port"
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 2
    interval            = 15
    timeout             = 5
  }
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group_attachment" "web" {
  count            = 2
  target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  target_id        = aws_instance.web[count.index].id
  port             = 80
}

resource "aws_lb_listener" "http" {
  load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.app.arn
  port              = 80
  protocol          = "HTTP"

  default_action {
    type             = "forward"
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "lab" {
  bucket        = "${var.name_prefix}-${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}"
  force_destroy = true

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-bucket"
  }
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

output "account_id" {
  value = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
}

output "region" {
  value = var.aws_region
}

output "alb_dns_name" {
  value = aws_lb.app.dns_name
}

output "instance_ids" {
  value = aws_instance.web[*].id
}

output "vpc_id" {
  value = aws_vpc.main.id
}

output "s3_bucket" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.lab.bucket
}

```

```hcl
    values = ["available"]
  }
}

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = "10.70.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-vpc" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_a" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.1.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-a" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_b" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.2.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[1]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-b" }
}

resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id
  tags   = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-igw" }
}

resource "aws_route_table" "public" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  route {
    cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-rt" }
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "a" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_a.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "b" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_b.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group" "web" {
  name   = "${var.name_prefix}-web-sg"
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description = "HTTP"
    from_port   = 80
    to_port     = 80
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_instance" "web" {
  count                       = 2
  ami                         = data.aws_ami.amazon_linux.id
  instance_type               = "t3.micro"
  subnet_id                   = count.index == 0 ? aws_subnet.public_a.id : aws_subnet.public_b.id
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  associate_public_ip_address = true

  user_data = <<-EOF
    #!/bin/bash
    dnf install -y nginx
    systemctl enable nginx
    systemctl start nginx
    echo "Terraform troubleshooting lab $(hostname)" > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
  EOF

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-web-${count.index + 1}"
  }
}

resource "aws_lb" "app" {
  name               = "${var.name_prefix}-alb"
  load_balancer_type = "application"
  security_groups    = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  subnets            = [aws_subnet.public_a.id, aws_subnet.public_b.id]
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group" "app" {
  name     = "${var.name_prefix}-tg"
  port     = 80
  protocol = "HTTP"
  vpc_id   = aws_vpc.main.id

  health_check {
    path                = "/"
    port                = "traffic-port"
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 2
    interval            = 15
    timeout             = 5
  }
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group_attachment" "web" {
  count            = 2
  target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  target_id        = aws_instance.web[count.index].id
  port             = 80
}

resource "aws_lb_listener" "http" {
  load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.app.arn
  port              = 80
  protocol          = "HTTP"

  default_action {
    type             = "forward"
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "lab" {
  bucket        = "${var.name_prefix}-${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}"
  force_destroy = true

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-bucket"
  }
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

output "account_id" {
  value = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
}

output "region" {
  value = var.aws_region
}

output "alb_dns_name" {
  value = aws_lb.app.dns_name
}

output "instance_ids" {
  value = aws_instance.web[*].id
}

output "vpc_id" {
  value = aws_vpc.main.id
}

output "s3_bucket" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.lab.bucket
}

```

## Failure injection / test

1. Deploy the baseline with `terraform init`, `terraform validate`, `terraform plan`, and `terraform apply`.
2. Apply this scenario's failure injection: **Make the remote state unavailable, restore it from the backend/recovery mechanism, then verify.**

5. Fix the root cause.
6. Run `terraform plan` and inspect the blast radius.

# Scenario 16: invalid AMI ID

**What you are reproducing:** Replace the dynamic AMI with a nonexistent AMI ID.

**Primary command:** `terraform apply`

## Complete Terraform code

```hcl
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 6.55"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.aws_region
}

variable "aws_region" {
  type    = string
  default = "ap-south-1"
}

variable "name_prefix" {
  type    = string
  default = "tf-trouble-lab"
}

data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

data "aws_ami" "amazon_linux" {
  most_recent = true
  owners      = ["amazon"]

  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["al2023-ami-*-x86_64"]
  }

  filter {
    name   = "state"
    values = ["available"]
  }
}

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = "10.70.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-vpc" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_a" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.1.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-a" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_b" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.2.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[1]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-b" }
}

resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id
  tags   = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-igw" }
}

resource "aws_route_table" "public" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  route {
    cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-rt" }
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "a" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_a.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "b" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_b.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group" "web" {
  name   = "${var.name_prefix}-web-sg"
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description = "HTTP"
    from_port   = 80
    to_port     = 80
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_instance" "web" {
  count                       = 2
  ami                         = "ami-00000000000000000"
  instance_type               = "t3.micro"
  subnet_id                   = count.index == 0 ? aws_subnet.public_a.id : aws_subnet.public_b.id
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  associate_public_ip_address = true

  user_data = <<-EOF
    #!/bin/bash
    dnf install -y nginx
    systemctl enable nginx
    systemctl start nginx
    echo "Terraform troubleshooting lab $(hostname)" > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
  EOF

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-web-${count.index + 1}"
  }
}

resource "aws_lb" "app" {
  name               = "${var.name_prefix}-alb"
  load_balancer_type = "application"
  security_groups    = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  subnets            = [aws_subnet.public_a.id, aws_subnet.public_b.id]
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group" "app" {
  name     = "${var.name_prefix}-tg"
  port     = 80
  protocol = "HTTP"
  vpc_id   = aws_vpc.main.id

  health_check {
    path                = "/"
    port                = "traffic-port"
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 2
    interval            = 15
    timeout             = 5
  }
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group_attachment" "web" {
  count            = 2
  target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  target_id        = aws_instance.web[count.index].id
  port             = 80
}

resource "aws_lb_listener" "http" {
  load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.app.arn
  port              = 80
  protocol          = "HTTP"

  default_action {
    type             = "forward"
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "lab" {
  bucket        = "${var.name_prefix}-${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}"
  force_destroy = true

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-bucket"
  }
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

output "account_id" {
  value = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
}

output "region" {
  value = var.aws_region
}

output "alb_dns_name" {
  value = aws_lb.app.dns_name
}

output "instance_ids" {
  value = aws_instance.web[*].id
}

output "vpc_id" {
  value = aws_vpc.main.id
}

output "s3_bucket" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.lab.bucket
}

```

```hcl
data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

data "aws_ami" "amazon_linux" {
  most_recent = true
  owners      = ["amazon"]

  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["al2023-ami-*-x86_64"]
  }

  filter {
    name   = "state"
    values = ["available"]
  }
}

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = "10.70.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-vpc" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_a" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.1.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-a" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_b" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.2.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[1]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-b" }
}

resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id
  tags   = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-igw" }
}

resource "aws_route_table" "public" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  route {
    cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-rt" }
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "a" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_a.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "b" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_b.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group" "web" {
  name   = "${var.name_prefix}-web-sg"
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description = "HTTP"
    from_port   = 80
    to_port     = 80
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_instance" "web" {
  count                       = 2
  ami                         = data.aws_ami.amazon_linux.id
  instance_type               = "t3.micro"
  subnet_id                   = count.index == 0 ? aws_subnet.public_a.id : aws_subnet.public_b.id
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  associate_public_ip_address = true

  user_data = <<-EOF
    #!/bin/bash
    dnf install -y nginx
    systemctl enable nginx
    systemctl start nginx
    echo "Terraform troubleshooting lab $(hostname)" > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
  EOF

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-web-${count.index + 1}"
  }
}

resource "aws_lb" "app" {
  name               = "${var.name_prefix}-alb"
  load_balancer_type = "application"
  security_groups    = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  subnets            = [aws_subnet.public_a.id, aws_subnet.public_b.id]
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group" "app" {
  name     = "${var.name_prefix}-tg"
  port     = 80
  protocol = "HTTP"
  vpc_id   = aws_vpc.main.id

  health_check {
    path                = "/"
    port                = "traffic-port"
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 2
    interval            = 15
    timeout             = 5
  }
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group_attachment" "web" {
  count            = 2
  target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  target_id        = aws_instance.web[count.index].id
  port             = 80
}

resource "aws_lb_listener" "http" {
  load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.app.arn
  port              = 80
  protocol          = "HTTP"

  default_action {
    type             = "forward"
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "lab" {
  bucket        = "${var.name_prefix}-${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}"
  force_destroy = true

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-bucket"
  }
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

output "account_id" {
  value = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
}

output "region" {
  value = var.aws_region
}

output "alb_dns_name" {
  value = aws_lb.app.dns_name
}

output "instance_ids" {
  value = aws_instance.web[*].id
}

output "vpc_id" {
  value = aws_vpc.main.id
}

output "s3_bucket" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.lab.bucket
}

```

## Failure injection / test

1. Deploy the baseline with `terraform init`, `terraform validate`, `terraform plan`, and `terraform apply`.
2. Apply this scenario's failure injection: **Introduce an externally managed/defaulted attribute that keeps changing.**

5. Fix the root cause.
6. Run `terraform plan` and inspect the blast radius.
7. Apply and verify the infrastructure.

```hcl
  cidr_block              = "10.70.1.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-a" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_b" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.2.0/24"

  tags   = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-igw" }

  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

    gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-rt" }
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "a" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_a.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id

resource "aws_route_table_association" "b" {

  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id

    to_port     = 0

    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

resource "aws_instance" "web" {

}

resource "aws_lb_listener" "http" {
  load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.app.arn
  port              = 80
  protocol          = "HTTP"

  default_action {
    type             = "forward"
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "lab" {

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-bucket"
  }
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

output "account_id" {

}

}

output "instance_ids" {
  value = aws_instance.web[*].id
}

output "vpc_id" {
```

```hcl
}

output "s3_bucket" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.lab.bucket
}

resource "aws_s3_object" "nonempty" {
```

```hcl
resource "aws_route_table" "public" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  route {
    cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-rt" }
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "a" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_a.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "b" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_b.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group" "web" {
  name   = "${var.name_prefix}-web-sg"
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description = "HTTP"
    from_port   = 80
    to_port     = 80
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_instance" "web" {
  count                       = 2
  ami                         = data.aws_ami.amazon_linux.id
  instance_type               = "t3.micro"
  subnet_id                   = count.index == 0 ? aws_subnet.public_a.id : aws_subnet.public_b.id
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  associate_public_ip_address = true

  user_data = <<-EOF
    #!/bin/bash
    dnf install -y nginx
    systemctl enable nginx
    systemctl start nginx
    echo "Terraform troubleshooting lab $(hostname)" > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
  EOF

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-web-${count.index + 1}"
  }
}

resource "aws_lb" "app" {
  name               = "${var.name_prefix}-alb"
  load_balancer_type = "application"
  security_groups    = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  subnets            = [aws_subnet.public_a.id, aws_subnet.public_b.id]
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group" "app" {
  name     = "${var.name_prefix}-tg"
  port     = 80
  protocol = "HTTP"
  vpc_id   = aws_vpc.main.id

  health_check {
    path                = "/"
    port                = "traffic-port"
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 2
    interval            = 15
    timeout             = 5
  }
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group_attachment" "web" {
  count            = 2
  target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  target_id        = aws_instance.web[count.index].id
  port             = 80
}

resource "aws_lb_listener" "http" {
  load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.app.arn
  port              = 80
  protocol          = "HTTP"

  default_action {
    type             = "forward"
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "lab" {
  bucket        = "${var.name_prefix}-${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}"
  force_destroy = true

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-bucket"
  }
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

output "account_id" {
  value = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
}

output "region" {
  value = var.aws_region
}

output "alb_dns_name" {
  value = aws_lb.app.dns_name
}

output "instance_ids" {
  value = aws_instance.web[*].id
}

output "vpc_id" {
  value = aws_vpc.main.id
}

output "s3_bucket" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.lab.bucket
}

```

```hcl
data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

data "aws_ami" "amazon_linux" {
  most_recent = true
  owners      = ["amazon"]

  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["al2023-ami-*-x86_64"]
  }

  filter {
    name   = "state"
    values = ["available"]
  }
}

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = "10.70.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-vpc" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_a" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.1.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-a" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_b" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.2.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[1]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-b" }
}

resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id
  tags   = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-igw" }
}

resource "aws_route_table" "public" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  route {
    cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-rt" }
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "a" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_a.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "b" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_b.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group" "web" {
  name   = "${var.name_prefix}-web-sg"
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description = "HTTP"
    from_port   = 80
    to_port     = 80
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_instance" "web" {
  count                       = 2
  ami                         = data.aws_ami.amazon_linux.id
  instance_type               = "t3.micro"
  subnet_id                   = count.index == 0 ? aws_subnet.public_a.id : aws_subnet.public_b.id
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  associate_public_ip_address = true

  user_data = <<-EOF
    #!/bin/bash
    dnf install -y nginx
    systemctl enable nginx
    systemctl start nginx
    echo "Terraform troubleshooting lab $(hostname)" > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
  EOF

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-web-${count.index + 1}"
  }
}

resource "aws_lb" "app" {
  name               = "${var.name_prefix}-alb"
  load_balancer_type = "application"
  security_groups    = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  subnets            = [aws_subnet.public_a.id, aws_subnet.public_b.id]
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group" "app" {
  name     = "${var.name_prefix}-tg"
  port     = 80
  protocol = "HTTP"
  vpc_id   = aws_vpc.main.id

  health_check {
    path                = "/"
    port                = "traffic-port"
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 2
    interval            = 15
    timeout             = 5
  }
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group_attachment" "web" {
  count            = 2
  target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  target_id        = aws_instance.web[count.index].id
  port             = 80
}

resource "aws_lb_listener" "http" {
  load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.app.arn
  port              = 80
  protocol          = "HTTP"

  default_action {
    type             = "forward"
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "lab" {
  bucket        = "${var.name_prefix}-${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}"
  force_destroy = true

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-bucket"
  }
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

output "account_id" {
  value = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
}

output "region" {
  value = var.aws_region
}

output "alb_dns_name" {
  value = aws_lb.app.dns_name
}

output "instance_ids" {
  value = aws_instance.web[*].id
}

output "vpc_id" {
  value = aws_vpc.main.id
}

output "s3_bucket" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.lab.bucket
}

```

5. Fix the root cause.
6. Run `terraform plan` and inspect the blast radius.
7. Apply and verify the infrastructure.

# Scenario 46: AWS quota failure

**What you are reproducing:** Scale a disposable resource count until an applicable AWS quota is reached; inspect service quotas.

**Primary command:** `terraform apply`

## Complete Terraform code

```hcl
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 6.55"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.aws_region
}

variable "aws_region" {
  type    = string
  default = "ap-south-1"
}

variable "name_prefix" {
  type    = string
  default = "tf-trouble-lab"
}

data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

data "aws_ami" "amazon_linux" {
  most_recent = true
  owners      = ["amazon"]

  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["al2023-ami-*-x86_64"]
  }

  filter {
    name   = "state"
    values = ["available"]
  }
}

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = "10.70.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-vpc" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_a" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.1.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-a" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_b" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.2.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[1]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-b" }
}

resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id
  tags   = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-igw" }
}

resource "aws_route_table" "public" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  route {
    cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-rt" }
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "a" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_a.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "b" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public_b.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group" "web" {
  name   = "${var.name_prefix}-web-sg"
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description = "HTTP"
    from_port   = 80
    to_port     = 80
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_instance" "web" {
  count                       = 2
  ami                         = data.aws_ami.amazon_linux.id
  instance_type               = "t3.micro"
  subnet_id                   = count.index == 0 ? aws_subnet.public_a.id : aws_subnet.public_b.id
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  associate_public_ip_address = true

  user_data = <<-EOF
    #!/bin/bash
    dnf install -y nginx
    systemctl enable nginx
    systemctl start nginx
    echo "Terraform troubleshooting lab $(hostname)" > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
  EOF

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-web-${count.index + 1}"
  }
}

resource "aws_lb" "app" {
  name               = "${var.name_prefix}-alb"
  load_balancer_type = "application"
  security_groups    = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  subnets            = [aws_subnet.public_a.id, aws_subnet.public_b.id]
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group" "app" {
  name     = "${var.name_prefix}-tg"
  port     = 80
  protocol = "HTTP"
  vpc_id   = aws_vpc.main.id

  health_check {
    path                = "/"
    port                = "traffic-port"
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 2
    interval            = 15
    timeout             = 5
  }
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group_attachment" "web" {
  count            = 2
  target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  target_id        = aws_instance.web[count.index].id
  port             = 80
}

resource "aws_lb_listener" "http" {
  load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.app.arn
  port              = 80
  protocol          = "HTTP"

  default_action {
    type             = "forward"
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "lab" {
  bucket        = "${var.name_prefix}-${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}"
  force_destroy = true

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-bucket"
  }
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

output "account_id" {
  value = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
}

output "region" {
  value = var.aws_region
}

output "alb_dns_name" {
  value = aws_lb.app.dns_name
}

output "instance_ids" {
  value = aws_instance.web[*].id
}

output "vpc_id" {
  value = aws_vpc.main.id
}

output "s3_bucket" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.lab.bucket
}
```

```hcl
  instance_type               = "t3.micro"
  subnet_id                   = count.index == 0 ? aws_subnet.public_a.id : aws_subnet.public_b.id
  vpc_security_group_ids      = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  associate_public_ip_address = true

  user_data = <<-EOF
    #!/bin/bash
    dnf install -y nginx
    systemctl enable nginx
    systemctl start nginx
    echo "Terraform troubleshooting lab $(hostname)" > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
  EOF

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-web-${count.index + 1}"
  }
}

resource "aws_lb" "app" {
  name               = "${var.name_prefix}-alb"
  load_balancer_type = "application"
  security_groups    = [aws_security_group.web.id]
  subnets            = [aws_subnet.public_a.id, aws_subnet.public_b.id]
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group" "app" {
  name     = "${var.name_prefix}-tg"
  port     = 80
  protocol = "HTTP"
  vpc_id   = aws_vpc.main.id

  health_check {
    path                = "/"
    port                = "traffic-port"
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 2
    interval            = 15
    timeout             = 5
  }
}

resource "aws_lb_target_group_attachment" "web" {
  count            = 2
  target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  target_id        = aws_instance.web[count.index].id
  port             = 80
}

resource "aws_lb_listener" "http" {
  load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.app.arn
  port              = 80
  protocol          = "HTTP"

  default_action {
    type             = "forward"
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.app.arn
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket" "lab" {
  bucket        = "${var.name_prefix}-${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}"
  force_destroy = true

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.name_prefix}-bucket"
  }
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

output "account_id" {
  value = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
}

output "region" {
  value = var.aws_region
}

output "alb_dns_name" {
  value = aws_lb.app.dns_name
}

output "instance_ids" {
  value = aws_instance.web[*].id
}

output "vpc_id" {
  value = aws_vpc.main.id
}

output "s3_bucket" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.lab.bucket
}

```

## Failure injection / test

1. Deploy the baseline with `terraform init`, `terraform validate`, `terraform plan`, and `terraform apply`.
2. Apply this scenario's failure injection: **Commit a dummy credential to a disposable repository and practice rotation/removal.**
3. Run `git log && git grep` and capture the exact symptom.
4. Check configuration → state → AWS remote resource → account/region → permissions/network/dependencies as applicable.
5. Fix the root cause.
6. Run `terraform plan` and inspect the blast radius.
7. Apply and verify the infrastructure.
8. For external-failure scenarios, restore the external system/credentials/backend/CI state after the test.

# Scenario 50: slow Terraform plan

**What you are reproducing:** Scale resource/data-source count or dependencies and measure plan time.

**Primary command:** `time terraform plan`

## Complete Terraform code

```hcl
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 6.55"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.aws_region
}

variable "aws_region" {
  type    = string
  default = "ap-south-1"
}

variable "name_prefix" {
  type    = string
  default = "tf-trouble-lab"
}

data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

data "aws_ami" "amazon_linux" {
  most_recent = true
  owners      = ["amazon"]

  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["al2023-ami-*-x86_64"]
  }

  filter {
    name   = "state"
    values = ["available"]
  }
}

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = "10.70.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-vpc" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_a" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.1.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-a" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_b" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.70.2.0/24"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[1]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-public-b" }
}

resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id
  tags   = { Name = "${var.name_prefix}-igw" }
}

resource "aws_route_table" "public" {

}

resource "aws_instance" "web" {
```

# Cleanup

For ordinary scenarios:

```bash
terraform destroy
```

For the non-empty S3 scenario, remove the lab object first if `force_destroy = false`.

For state/import scenarios, understand whether Terraform is still managing the remote resource before destroying anything.
